title: NASA SVS CGI Moon Kit (2019 maps)
credit: NASA’s Scientific Visualization Studio; LRO / LOLA and LROC instrument teams

elevation.encoding: little-endian uint16, row-major, north to south, west to east

imagery.processing: RGB JPEG, quality 94, no chroma subsampling
imagery.limits: Visualization mosaic. Polar latitudes beyond ±70° filled with LOLA albedo; source dropouts inpainted by NASA. Not scientific reflectance.

limits: Global visualization only. Mesh resamples the raster. Not wheel-scale terrain, validated hazard data, rover dynamics, or date-specific lighting.

surfaceNormals.encoding: linear RGB8, normalized object-space XYZ encoded as normal * 0.5 + 0.5
surfaceNormals.method: Central differences on native LOLA pixel centers, longitude wrapping, one-sided latitude edges; spherical physical spacing with radius 1737400 m + elevation.
surfaceNormals.limits: Shading derivative of the same 16 px/degree DEM. No new measured resolution or invented craters. RGB8 normals have quantization error; they are a display asset, not a scientific slope product.

display.illumination: Illustrative directional lighting; adjustable solar elevation 5–70 degrees; not tied to a mission epoch.
display.terrainShadows: Display shadow map on the regional mesh; not a validated illumination or permanently shadowed region product.

simulation.physics: executed MuJoCo rigid contact and Gazebo Harmonic / DART in a local Linux VM with ROS 2 telemetry; native benchmark passed
simulation.models: declared rover mobility; optional declared single-node battery/enclosure thermal screening with thermostat and charging inhibition; SPICE directions with sampled terrain horizons

historical_temperature_context.role: Historical surface context; explicitly copied values are constant ground scenarios, not mission-date forecasts.

sites.name: Shackleton rim
sites.origin: Published Site04 ROI record 4, converted from polar stereographic X/Y metres

terrain_uncertainty.source: NASA PGDA78 published statistical cloned surfaces
terrain_uncertainty.value_convention: Complete height surfaces, used directly; not additive error offsets.
terrain_uncertainty.origin_policy: All realizations retain the nominal local ENU origin.
terrain_uncertainty.support_mask: Native nominal LDEC return counts; zero means an interpolated cell, positive means returns in that cell.

observed_shadow_validation.source: NASA PGDA90 projected LROC NAC scenes and published renderings; PDS4 acquisition labels
observed_shadow_validation.purpose: Bounded scientific validation, not active rover-site imagery.
observed_shadow_validation.terrain_for_comparison: Existing PGDA90 80 m regional DEM, plus separate production PGDA78 5 m site comparisons where the observed footprint overlaps. Only one observed epoch overlaps the curated sites.

report.status: Bounded comparisons recorded; numerical targets are not all met. No operational accuracy bound.

landingPreview.description: Orthographic near-side display with illustrative lighting. Uses the existing Moon Kit imagery and DEM-derived normals.

landingElevation.description: Orthographic near-side elevation, with colors clamped at -4500 and +4500 m relative to the 1737.4 km sphere. Illustrative relief shading.

orbital_references.software: NASA GMAT R2026a, official signed universal macOS distribution
orbital_references.role: Offline reference benchmark, separate from the surface/dynamics models

report.status: Both original reference cases passed. Bounded departure search and full clearance/repropagation gates remain pending.

mobility_validation.source: NASA Glenn TREC / MGRU3 published experimental plot points and author rig definitions
mobility_validation.status: Independent rigid-contact discrepancy test; no lunar soil calibration established
mobility_validation.terrain_role: No new lunar terrain, regolith map or mission mobility response added.

scm_validation.source: Same NASA Glenn TREC Earth-gravity published plot points; no new lunar measurements
